clue.text: Those employing ramp turn left on returning aboard

parts.note: aboard means on a steamship, SS, so its two letters sit either side of the rest
to wind is to turn, as a handle or key

indicators.note: returning means the short word for on is read backwards

parts.note: RE means on, about or concerning
aboard means on a steamship, SS, so its two letters sit either side of the rest

explanation.surface: Drivers using a ramp to board a ferry are told to turn left once back on deck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ramp' is old slang for a swindle, not a slope. 'Aboard' means inside SS (steamship), so its two letters wrap the rest; 'returning' reverses the short word for on.
explanation.definitionFit: In old slang a ramp is a racket or confidence trick, so people who run one are cheats.

clue.text: Block times for visit

parts.note: to stop something is to block it
by means times in multiplication, as in three by four

explanation.surface: Blocking out times in a diary for a visit.
explanation.definitionFit: To drop in briefly on someone is a casual phrasal verb for paying a short call.

clue.text: Press, first alternative to rack?

parts.note: to iron clothes is to press them
maiden means first, as in a maiden voyage or speech

explanation.surface: Choosing between pressing clothes first or hanging them on a rack.
explanation.walkthrough: The rack here is the torture device, not a clothes rail; the question mark flags the definition by example.
explanation.definitionFit: Both were medieval torture devices, a spiked cabinet being one alternative to stretching on the rack.

clue.text: Provocation of French intended

parts.note: de is the French word for of
one's intended is the person one is engaged to marry

explanation.surface: A provocative act by one's French betrothed.
explanation.definitionFit: Open defiance is a challenge or provocation to authority, so the two nouns overlap in sense.

clue.text: Bird turned up covered in detergent

indicators.note: in a down clue turned up means the letters are read from bottom to top, backwards
covered in means the letters sit inside the word detergent

explanation.surface: A bird found smeared in washing-up liquid, as after a spill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Covered in' points to TERGE inside 'detergent'; 'turned up' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: This white heron of marshes and coasts is a well-known wading species.

clue.text: Roadside police may carry out this arrest after jam

definitions.text: Roadside police may carry out this

indicators.note: after places the word for arrest following the word for jam

parts.note: being in a jam is being in a spot of trouble
to check something is to arrest or halt it

explanation.surface: Traffic police stop a driver after a jam on the road.
explanation.definitionFit: Police pull over vehicles at random to inspect them, a sudden unannounced inspection.

clue.text: Drawing energy released by power source can be tricky

parts.note: drawing is a form of art

indicators.note: released by means the letter for energy is let go from the power source

parts.note: fuel is a source of power
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Getting a drawing of a power station's energy release right can be tricky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Released by' drops E from FUEL to leave FUL.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone crafty or cunning is tricky, like the Artful Dodger in Oliver Twist.

clue.text: Announcement of grain yield

indicators.note: an announcement is spoken, so the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: a seed is a grain, as of corn

explanation.surface: A farmer announces the grain yield of the harvest.
explanation.definitionFit: To give up territory or a point is to yield it, a close synonym.

clue.text: Bird to emerge from shell, head first

indicators.note: first puts the word for head before the rest

parts.note: nut is slang for the head
chicks hatch when they break out of the egg

explanation.surface: A chick breaking out of its egg head first.
explanation.definitionFit: This small tree-climbing songbird is known for cracking nuts wedged in bark.

clue.text: Arriviste from north in disorderly rave-up

indicators.note: in means the letter for north is placed within the rearranged letters
disorderly means the letters of rave-up are jumbled

parts.note: N is the compass abbreviation for north

explanation.surface: A social climber up from the north at a riotous party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Disorderly' rearranges RAVEUP to PARVEU, and 'in' puts N inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are French-derived terms for an upstart newcomer who has gained wealth or status but lacks acceptance.

clue.text: Employer drained after working away for purchase

indicators.note: after puts the drained employer's letters at the end

parts.note: a machine that is on is working
off means away, as in going off

indicators.note: drained means the inside of the word is emptied, leaving its outer letters

explanation.surface: An exhausted boss, after working away, thinks of going shopping.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods that are available to buy are being offered for sale, an idiom for purchasable.

clue.text: Pulp novel changing hands

indicators.note: the right hand is swapped for the left, so the letter for right becomes the letter for left

parts.note: novel means new or fresh

explanation.surface: A pulp novel being sold on from one owner to another.
explanation.walkthrough: R (right) and L (left) are the 'hands' swapped.
explanation.definitionFit: The soft fleshy part of a fruit is its pulp, so the two words are synonyms.

clue.text: Doctor bitten by crow sick at heart and windy

indicators.note: bitten by means the doctor is held inside the word for crow

parts.note: to crow is to boast
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification

indicators.note: at heart takes the central letters of the word sick

explanation.surface: A doctor pecked by a crow feels queasy and flatulent.
explanation.definitionFit: Windy speech is pompous and inflated, the same as grandiloquent talk.

clue.text: Seafood from Bali cooked in cabin

indicators.note: in means the rearranged letters sit inside the cabin

parts.note: a hut is a simple cabin

indicators.note: cooked means the letters of Bali are reworked

explanation.surface: Fish from Bali prepared in a beach shack.
explanation.definitionFit: This large flatfish is eaten widely, an example of food from the sea.

clue.text: Mad family a potential cause of embarrassment

parts.note: bananas is slang for mad
kin are one's family

explanation.surface: A crazy family is a likely source of mortification.
explanation.definitionFit: Slipping on fruit peel is the classic pratfall, so the term means a pitfall that leads to humiliation.

clue.text: A little garlic in cold relish

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
to relish something is to love it

explanation.surface: A small amount of garlic in a chilled condiment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Relish' looks like a sauce but is the verb to enjoy.
explanation.definitionFit: A bulb of garlic splits into segments, each a small part of the whole.

clue.text: Hospital expert tipped to run leaderless institution

indicators.note: tipped means tipped over, so the hospital and expert letters are read backwards

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs
a pro is an expert

indicators.note: leaderless means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: to manage a business is to run it

explanation.surface: A hospital specialist is tipped to take charge of an institution lacking a head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tipped' turns HPRO into ORPH; 'leaderless' cuts MANAGE to ANAGE.
explanation.definitionFit: A home for children without parents is a kind of residential institution.

clue.text: Fly westward, say, with poor illumination

indicators.note: in an across clue westward means read right to left, backwards

parts.note: eg, for example, is what say means
dim light is poor illumination

explanation.surface: Flying west in the dim light, for instance.
explanation.definitionFit: This tiny biting insect is a gnat-like species of the order of two-winged insects.

clue.text: One's invested in phone for rally

indicators.note: invested in means put inside the word for phone

parts.note: a mobile is a phone
one's is read as I'S, I for one plus the S

explanation.surface: Someone puts money into a phone campaign to stir up support.
explanation.definitionFit: To rally troops or supporters is to gather and organise them for action.

clue.text: Steal very small amount

definitions.meaning: as much as fits between finger and thumb, like salt

explanation.surface: Pilfering just a tiny bit.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for a petty theft, and also a tiny quantity held between thumb and finger.

clue.text: Valuable source I abandoned under pressure

indicators.note: in a down clue under puts the rearranged letters below the letter for pressure

parts.note: P is the physics symbol for pressure

indicators.note: abandoned means wild or unrestrained, so the letters are set loose

explanation.surface: A precious source of supply given up under duress.
explanation.definitionFit: Something of great worth is prized and dear, a near synonym for valuable.

clue.text: Satisfactory cuts for every card game

indicators.note: cuts means the satisfactory word cuts into the word for every

parts.note: per means for every, as in per head
OK means satisfactory

explanation.surface: A fair cut of the deck for every player in a card game.
explanation.definitionFit: This betting game of hands is the classic example of a gambling card game.

clue.text: Subordinate to remain without water, close to death

parts.note: to be is to exist or remain
a neat drink is served undiluted

indicators.note: close to means the end letter of death

explanation.surface: Kept below others, living with no water as death approaches.
explanation.definitionFit: Being lower in rank than someone is to be under or below them.

clue.text: A male, or sometimes a female, team getting in beers

definitions.text: A male, or sometimes a female

indicators.note: getting in means the team goes inside the beers

parts.note: ales are beers
XI, eleven in Roman numerals, is a cricket or football team

explanation.surface: A man, or occasionally a woman, from the team buys a round of beers.
explanation.definitionFit: This given name is used chiefly for boys but also for girls.

clue.text: Buyer's limit included in letter

indicators.note: included in means the limit sits inside the letter

parts.note: vee is the spelled-out name of the letter V
an end is a limit

explanation.surface: A purchaser's spending cap stated in a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: In legal language the person to whom goods are sold is the purchaser, the counterpart of the seller.

clue.text: Hang about like security service intercepting notes

parts.note: as means like, in comparisons

indicators.note: intercepting means the security service cuts in between the notes

parts.note: so and te are notes of the sol-fa scale
the CIA is the US intelligence agency

explanation.surface: Spies loiter, intercepting musical messages.
explanation.definitionFit: To hang about with people is to keep company with them, a phrasal-verb synonym.

clue.text: Jet from Brazil unloaded in small enclosure

indicators.note: in means the emptied Brazil goes inside the small enclosure

parts.note: an SAE, stamped addressed envelope, is a small item enclosed with a letter

indicators.note: unloaded means Brazil is emptied of its middle, leaving its outer letters

explanation.surface: An aircraft from Brazil unloads its cargo in a small pen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jet' is the colour black, not a plane.
explanation.definitionFit: In heraldry and poetry the word means black, the colour of jet stone.

clue.text: Draw involving clubs proceeds without honour?

indicators.note: involving means the clubs letter is wrapped inside the draw

parts.note: to lure is to draw in
C is the card-suit abbreviation for clubs

explanation.surface: A raffle draw with clubs taking the takings dishonestly.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase 'filthy' money explains the question mark: ill-gotten gain.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is used scornfully of money, especially profit gained dishonourably.

clue.text: Scrabble champion's prime rule

indicators.note: prime means the first or foremost letter of champion's

parts.note: a law is a rule

explanation.surface: A Scrabble champion's most important rule.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scrabble' is the verb to scratch or grope, not the board game.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrabble at something is to scratch or grope with nails, the verb meaning of the answer.

clue.text: Plot to trap seal thwarted

indicators.note: to trap means the plot surrounds the seal

parts.note: a bed is a garden plot
a lock seals something shut

explanation.surface: A scheme to catch a seal comes to nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Seal' is the act of closing, not the animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A plan that has been obstructed or stopped has been foiled.

clue.text: Ferocious marine syndicate

parts.note: marine means of the sea
a ring is a group or syndicate, as of criminals

explanation.surface: A fierce gang operating at sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Intense, scorching heat or criticism is fierce, so the words overlap as adjectives.

clue.text: Money initially denied to servicemen restored from then on

indicators.note: restored means the remaining letters are put back together in a new order
denied to means the letter is taken away from servicemen
initially takes the first letter of Money

explanation.surface: Since the cash was withheld from troops, it has now been given back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Denied to' removes M from SERVICEMEN; 'restored' rearranges SERVICEEN.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means continuously since that time, the same as thereafter.
